data_format.title: Data format
data_format.description: Same options as the YAML configuration of the core InfluxDB integration. Copy your values from there so existing queries keep working. Leave a field empty for the core default.

data_description.default_measurement: core: default_measurement. Used when the entity has no value for the option above. Empty: the entity ID.
data_description.override_measurement: core: override_measurement. Writes every point to this measurement.
data_description.tags: core: tags. One key=value per line, for example source=HA.
data_description.component_config: core: component_config. Entity ID mapped to override_measurement and/or ignore_attributes.
data_description.component_config_domain: core: component_config_domain. Domain mapped to override_measurement and/or ignore_attributes.
data_description.component_config_glob: core: component_config_glob. Pattern such as sensor.*_temp mapped to override_measurement and/or ignore_attributes.

reconfigure.title: Change connection
reconfigure.description: The new connection is tested with a real write request. Leave the token empty to keep the current one. Labels and data format are kept.

reauth_confirm.title: New token
reauth_confirm.description: The server rejected the token of {title}. Enter a token with write permission for the bucket.

error.invalid_auth: The token is invalid or has no write permission.
error.same_label: A label can only be in one of the two fields.
error.invalid_component_config: Expected a mapping to override_measurement (text) and/or ignore_attributes (list).
